parameters.formTitle: Flow 3 — TAM Ingestion (CSV ou Sales Nav search)
parameters.formDescription: Soit upload un CSV (Phantombuster, etc.), soit lance une search LinkedIn Company directement (laisse CSV vide). Dedup tam_last_scrap < 30j.

values.fieldLabel: CSV upload (optionnel — laisse vide si tu lances une search ci-dessous)
Max companies (safety cap, leave empty for all)
Search query (mots-clés LinkedIn, ex: SaaS B2B)
Industry IDs (comma-separated, 4=Software Dev — voir doc harvestapi)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ filterGroups: [{ filters: [{ propertyName: 'tam_domain', operator: 'EQ', value: $json.domain }] }], properties: ['tam_domain', 'tam_status', 'tam_last_scrap'], limit: 1 }) }}

conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { const e = $json._existing; if (!e || !e.properties) return false; const last = e.properties.tam_last_scrap; if (!last) return false; const ageDays = (Date.now() - new Date(last).getTime()) / 86400000; return ageDays < 30; })() }}

parameters.text: ={{ '📋 *Flow 3:* CSV parsed\n*Companies kept:* ' + $('2b. Map CSV columns + cap').all().length + ' (after domain filter)' }}

={{ (() => { let pushed = 0; let skipped = 0; try { pushed = $('4.5b Push HS Company brut').all().length; } catch(e) {} try { skipped = $('3.5d PATCH tam_last_scrap (skipped)').all().length; } catch(e) {} return '💾 *Flow 3:* HubSpot push done\n*Pushed:* ' + pushed + ' new/updated\n*Skipped (<30j):* ' + skipped; })() }}

parameters.customBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ searchQuery: $('1c. Normalize Input').first().json.searchQuery, locations: $('1c. Normalize Input').first().json.locations, industryIds: $('1c. Normalize Input').first().json.industryIds, companySize: $('1c. Normalize Input').first().json.companySize, scraperMode: 'full', takePages: $('1c. Normalize Input').first().json.takePages, maxItems: $('1c. Normalize Input').first().json.max_companies }) }}
